channel.title: Octonauts
channel.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Kwazii and Dashi become entangled in a strange deep sea creature, a siphonophore, and when a geyser blasts it towards the surface, the Octonauts must stop its ascent before it bursts.
